Name: Swimming Pool Decor
Author: Everbloom1
Description:
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/XfTjcrVC/GIF-2026-4-2.gif[/img][/center]
[center][size=4][font=Arial Black]Installation & Usage  (v1.0.1)[/font][/size][/center]
Quick Start:
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/url] [/*]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]. [/*]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]. [/*]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties[/url] (MMAP). [/*]
[*]Download the mod files and unzip them into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*][b]Important:[/b] CP version and AT version are now integrated into one package. Ensure both Content Patcher and Alternative Textures are installed.[/*]
[/list]Feature Access
[list]
[*]Furniture (CP): Includes 40+ pool-themed items. Obtain them via the Furniture Catalogue or search "pool" in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url].[/*]
[*]Paths (AT): Use the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]Paint Bucket[/url]﻿ or [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Spray-Can-Tool]Spray Can[/url] on Cobblestone or Wood paths to apply pool textures.[/*]
[*]Swimming & Effects (MMAP): To use the Pool Entry (to swim) and see animated pool decor effects, you must install MMAP.[/*]
[*]How to swim: Place a Pool Entry (any-side entry) or a Pool Ladder (top-side entry) from the Rug category and walk through.[/*]
[/list][center][size=4][font=Arial Black]Update Notes (v1.0.1) [/font][/size][/center]
[color=#f1c232][b]If you are updating from a previous version, please read carefully:[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Item Removals: Some furniture items and path textures have been removed or modified.[/*]
[*]Broken Textures: If you see a "Prohibited" sign, please pick up and delete the old furniture. For the broken paths, re-pave the area using the Spray Can or Paint Bucket.[/*]
[*]Limitations Without MMAP: Pool entries will not function. Umbrella shadow layer may have rendering issues. Animated pool decor icons will appear blank.[/*]
[/list][center][size=4][font=Arial Black]Potential Bug[/font][/size][/center]
Do not rename the mod folder after you have already paved the retextured paths (AT) in your game. This will cause Alternative Textures to throw errors.
How to fix folder-related errors:
[list=1]
[*]Remove the mod from your folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game, load your save, then save and exit.[/*]
[*]Rename the mod folder to your preferred name.[/*]
[*]Re-install the mod and launch again.[/*]
[/list][color=#f1c232][b]Please avoid placing pool ladders at the edge of the map or near rivers.[/b][/color] These are not intended to grant access to non-walkable areas; placing them at the map's boundary will cause you to get stuck after entering the water.

[center][size=4][font=Arial Black]Special Thanks [/font][/size][/center]
Huge thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato]mushymato[/url] for adding PoolEntry action to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]MMAP[/url] and providing good advice!
